body: For the BUG-2565 (#4007) rework lane and whoever reviews it: besides the launch-input ratchet, my dell1 run of the old merge result (c219a07bf39 = integration 47fcbc060de + #4007 head 30e4a10ed702) had one aida-core failure: git_ops::commit_failure::tests::bug034_permission_denied_lock_is_not_retried (209 passed, 1 failed under the filter `git_ops`). The same test passes alone on dell1 at plain integration 47fcbc060de. #4007 changes aida-core/src/git_ops.rs, so it may be caused by the change, or it may only fail when run with the other git_ops tests. Not yet narrowed: I have not run it alone on the #4007 head. Please have the lane run `cargo test -p aida-core git_ops` on its new head before it asks for review.
subject: #4007: aida-core bug034 lock test failed on the merge result (dell1)
